title: Fun Addition to Our Christmas Village
text: Fun Addition to Our Christmas Village. This is a fun addition to our Christmas village. It requires batteries for the lights to work. In previous years we have put our village up high that required a ladder to access, so the batteries were a pain to deal with. This year we are setting it up on the bakers rack so replacing batteries won't be difficult. This looks pretty good. The faces of the kids look a bit odd, but that's okay. It does have an old fashioned vibe. I am excited to place this with our village pieces and get it all set up.
